blurb: Westland Boatyard and Marina is located on the Intracoastal Waterway in Titusville, Florida. With 55 wet-slips and 6+ acres of do-it-yourself upland dry yard, the marina is very popular among Do-It-Yourself boaters. Our travel lift can haul out boats to 60' and 50 tons*.
